test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The Principal said to the students, “Listen to the announcement carefully.”

options.text: The Principal ordered the students that listen to the announcement carefully.
The Principal told the students that listen to the announcement carefully.
The Principal ordered the students to listen to the announcement carefully.
The Principal suggested the students that they should listen to the announcement carefully.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'The Principal ordered the students to listen to the announcement carefully'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given sentence: The Principal said to the students, “Listen to the announcement carefully.” 
 
• After analyzing the sentence it is oberved that the direct speech is a imperative sentence.
 
• Here the principle ordered the student .
 
• The rule to convert in the indirect speech
 
• When we change an imperative from direct speech into indirect speech we **use the verbs told, ordered or commanded and we use the infinitive with to instead of the imperative**.

​Hence the indirect speech will be ***The Principal ordered the students to listen to the announcement carefully. ***So ***option(3)*** is ***correct.***

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__***Imperative sentences begin with a verb in the simple present tense. An imperative sentence expresses ideas such as advice, order, request, suggestion, instruction, permission, allowance etc. **In order to change an imperative sentence into the indirect speech, we use a to-infinitive.**
